title: Steady
why: The most common setup among self-serve launches still alive: ~85 SOL to graduate, a flat 1-3% fee, 100% of post-graduation liquidity permanently locked. Rule frozen on the discovery sample and confirmed on two untouched samples.

title: Anti-sniper
why: Same graduation and lock as Steady, but the fee starts at 50% and decays to 2% over the first 2 minutes so first-second bots pay heavily. Chosen on the discovery sample; the holdout had too few matching launches, and the much larger confirmation sample then confirmed it.
